001: What's the weather like today? Did you check the forecast?
They say it's going to be warm and sunny. Perfect for a walk.
Really? Then we can go to the park after lunch.
Yeah, I'm all for it. We should bring some water with us.
Of course, I already put a bottle in my bag.
So, it's settled. We'll meet at two o'clock.
002: It's so windy outside! Did you see?
Yeah, I almost lost my hat when I was walking here.
I think it's going to start raining by the evening.
Maybe. The sky is already covered with clouds.
Then you'd better take an umbrella if you go for a walk.
Good idea. Thanks for the heads-up.
003: It's so cold today, it's freezing!
Yeah, minus ten, probably. I got cold on my way here.
Me too. Even with gloves on, my hands got cold.
They say tomorrow it's going to be even colder.
Really? Then we need to dress warmer.
Agreed. Better to wear a sweater and a scarf.
004: Finally, the sun came out! I'm so tired of the rain.
Yeah, the whole week was gray and wet.
Now we can open the windows and air out the room.
Exactly. And the weather is great for a jog.
You run in the mornings? I didn't know that.
Yeah, I try to go twice a week if the weather allows.
005: Did you hear the forecast for the weekend?
Yeah, they're promising snow and a little below zero.
Hmm, but I wanted to go out of town.
By car it'll be fine, they clear the roads.
You're right. But I'm afraid it'll be slippery.
Don't worry, we'll drive carefully, I'm behind the wheel.
006: It's so hot today! I can barely breathe.
Yeah, plus thirty, and not a single cloud.
I'm so tired of this summer. I want some cool weather.
They say there's going to be a thunderstorm at the end of the week.
I hope that's true. The rain would freshen everything up.
Agreed, it's always easier to breathe after a thunderstorm.
007: Look, it's so foggy outside! You can't see anything.
Yeah, I could barely find my way to the bus stop.
I wonder when it will clear up.
Usually the fog goes away by noon.
Good. Because I wanted to go to the store.
Then you'd better wait until midday, it'll be safer.
008: It's so beautiful today! The sky is clear, not a single cloud.
Yeah, perfect weather for a photo shoot.
I was just thinking of taking pictures of the sunset.
Great idea. I know a nice spot by the river.
Really? Then will you show it to me?
Of course, let's go after work if we make it before sunset.
009: Did you notice how suddenly it got cold?
Yeah, yesterday it was plus fifteen, and today it's plus five.
I don't even know what to wear.
Better wear a jacket and a scarf so you don't get cold.
You're right. I guess autumn has already arrived.
Looks like it. Get ready for rain and wind.
010: What's the weather going to be like tomorrow? Do you know?
According to the forecast, rain and strong wind.
That's a shame. I wanted to have a picnic with my friends.
Maybe you can move it to the weekend?
Yeah, I guess we'll do that.
Good call. They're promising sun and warm weather on Saturday.
